en.title: Lexicographically Smallest Rearrangement of a Symmetric Name
en.description:
The input is guaranteed to be a lowercase palindrome. Rearrange all of its characters and output the lexicographically smallest string that is still a palindrome; leaving the original string unchanged is allowed.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a palindrome of length 1..100000, containing only lowercase letters.
en.explanation: Example 1: a appears twice and b three times, so the left half is ab, the center is b and the right half is ba; output abbba. Example 2: the left half is abc, which mirrors to abccba. Example 3: a single z stays unchanged.
hints: Put half of each character into the left half in ascending letter order, put the only character with an odd count in the middle, and make the right half the reverse of the left half.
